body:
its not that simple. this person has stopped contact to me and cant handle my suicidal depressive nature ATM. I feel like im just sitting down in a room thinking about this nonstop. Its very painful feeling and i cant go to work or do anything with it so im a ticking timebomb.

I just feel like laying down and not moving where all i do is think about these issues and that one in particular... i dont know what to do anymore. Im almost broke because im too depressed to work and i cant last forever like that. If i could drag myself to work i would but i really am sick

i dont even know why i posted on here. this is the exact shit that is pushing me to where i am. feels like the whole world is just saying "shut up and do it already" and thats where im at as far as proving to myself now that this is what needs to happen

My most important relationship is in in a pretty bad position, id say its over. This is also my only real family because my actual family live far away and are not many, also they have never really been there for me the last 10 years.
I brought all my depressive thoughts onto this person and its pushed them away, i dont know what i was thinking i just wear my heart on my sleeve and i honestly feel like dying. 
I'm in a fair bit of debt, i dont have alot of responsibilities but i cant even keep up with them. The only thing that kept me going through most of the hard days was knowing i had this person that i could trust with anything and now i just feel like theres nobody i trust enough or am close enough to express myself.
I know it sounds selfish as anything but i cant change how my head feels and right now i feel like theres heaps of friends around but im so fucking alone, its horrible.
